questions.q: What habit does Jack Canfield say you must stop to take control of your life?
questions.why: He states stopping complaining puts you as director of your life.

a: Deciding the fate of every unfinished task
questions.why: He suggests using a weekend to act on all pending projects.

questions.q: Which example illustrates the cost of unchecked spending?
a: Spending a $500 bonus on a TV instead of saving
Investing in stocks and losing money
Buying a car and missing a vacation
questions.why: He asks readers to examine a $500 gift spent on a TV.

questions.q: How does the story of Nick Sitzman relate to mindset?
a: Negative thoughts contributed to his tragic end
questions.why: Nick's hopeless thoughts are linked to his death in the wagon.

questions.q: What role does personal responsibility play in Canfield's lessons?
a: It is the core reason for success or failure
It is less important than luck
It is secondary to external factors
questions.why: He emphasizes you are the director of your own life.
